verified_findings.title: Deferred kiosk-card late-payment vs 15-min auto-reject: no TPE-fund reconciliation (DORMANT under V1 Plan B)
verified_findings.grep_evidence: CleanupStalePendingKioskOrders.php:64 OrderStateMachine::apply($locked, OrderStatus::REJECTED, ...); line 86 OrderCanceled::dispatch($order) (stock release). OrderController.php:209 'if ((int) $locked->status !== OrderStatus::PENDING)' sets nonConfirmableStatus; line 238 returns response([...],422) 'Payment confirmation is no longer accepted'. Reachability gate confirmed: config/kiosk.php:54 KIOSK_PAYMENT_ROUTE_ALL_TO_COUNTER default true (filter_var env(...,true)); KioskPaymentComponent.vue:421 confirmCounterRoute() forces counter route. CleanupVsConfirmRaceTest.php:57 fixture transaction_id 'FK-M06-LATE-TPE', line 63 assertStatus(422), line 68 asserts payment_status stays UNPAID — test asserts the data-integrity outcome but is SILENT on TPE-captured funds / refund / reconciliation.
verified_findings.recommendation: No V1 action while Plan B active (path dormant — all kiosk payments route to counter). When Plan A (kiosk TPE auth+capture) is wired, add a reconciliation guard: paymentConfirm landing on a REJECTED/CANCELED row whose transaction_id indicates a real capture must alert + queue refund/void rather than silent 422. Extend CleanupVsConfirmRaceTest to assert that branch. Touches no frozen zone (controller + job not §7). Track as Plan-A precondition, not a V1 LOCAL blocker.

verified_findings.title: Stale-order stock release scoped to source_surface='kiosk' only; web/mobile abandoned orders leak branch counters (LATENT — no V1 web/mobile API wireup)
verified_findings.grep_evidence: CleanupStalePendingKioskOrders.php:38 '->where('source_surface', 'kiosk')' + line 39 whereIn order_type [KIOSK,TAKEAWAY]. FrontendOrderService.php:512 decrementForOrder() is unconditional inside the create closure; lines 520-523 set source_surface = $isKiosk ? 'kiosk' : 'web' (so a non-kiosk PENDING/UNPAID order is tagged 'web' and is never picked up by the cleanup filter). routes/api.php my-order group at line 603 exposes only GET show routes — the order-CREATE route is the kiosk-shared /api/frontend/order, so no live V1 client POSTs a non-kiosk order through myOrderStore. Asymmetry is latent.
verified_findings.recommendation: Per CLAUDE.md §3bis mobile/web are STANDALONE with NO API wireup in V1 — latent, not active. When web/mobile wireup lands (V2), broaden the cleanup filter to whereIn(source_surface,['kiosk','web']) with a surface-appropriate TTL, or make the decrement conditional on payment confirmation for non-kiosk surfaces. No frozen zone touched.

verified_findings.title: No integration test exercises kiosk loyalty-redeem + REAL quote-seal together (seal stubbed to no-op)
verified_findings.grep_evidence: KioskLoyaltyLedgerAtomicTest.php:36 calls bypassKioskQuoteSealForLoyaltySentinel(); lines 174-181 'this->app->instance(\App\Services\Order\OrderQuoteService::class, new class { public function sealForCommit(): \App\Models\OrderQuote { return new \App\Models\OrderQuote(); } })' — seal disabled for all loyalty atomicity tests. Companion QuoteBindingTest.php exercises real sealForCommit but its fixture has NO loyalty (grep loyalty_code = 0 matches in that file; line 159 tax_rate => 0). The two invariants (loyalty ledger atomicity + quote-seal 409 total-mismatch) are never asserted on the SAME request.
verified_findings.recommendation: Add a kiosk feature test posting a loyalty-redeem order WITHOUT stubbing OrderQuoteService, asserting (a) sealForCommit 409 fires if the sealed total diverges from the loyalty-adjusted total, and (b) ledger rollback on seal failure. Test-only, no frozen-zone touch. Low priority: both production paths independently verified-correct; this is assertion-coverage, not a live defect.

verified_findings.title: POS idempotency-recovery returns existing Order using client-supplied branch_id BEFORE the create-path branch-ownership check — VERIFIED NON-exploitable via BranchScope
verified_findings.grep_evidence: OrderService.php:629 (in 615-625 region) '$targetBranchId = (int) ($request->branch_id ?: 0)' client-supplied; line 645 '$existing = $this->findExistingOrderForIdempotencyRecovery($idempotencyKey,$targetBranchId,$recoveryCustomerId)'; line 647 'return $existing' — runs BEFORE the branch-ownership guard at lines 671-677 ('if (! isGlobalAdmin && (authBranchId<=0 || request->branch_id !== authBranchId)) throw 403'), which executes only inside the create closure. findExistingOrderForIdempotencyRecovery (OrderService.php:2850-2861) uses plain Order::query()->where('idempotency_key')->where('branch_id',$branchId) with NO withoutGlobalScope. BranchScope.php:33-36 admin (branch_id=0) returns early; line 39 staff scoped '$builder->where($field,'=',$userBranch)' → branch-A operator passing branch_id=B yields branch_id=B AND branch_id=A = empty. Only global Admin (by design) can pass arbitrary branch_id. NON-exploitable.
verified_findings.recommendation: No production fix for V1 (BranchScope is the enforcing layer; single-branch branch_id=1 has no second branch). Optional V2 hardening: move the branch-ownership assert ABOVE the recovery return, or assert $existing->branch_id === $authBranchId on recovery, so the guarantee does not silently depend on the global scope. Add a regression test pinning cross-branch-recovery=empty before V2. Not a frozen-zone file.
